# Private cutoff transport for selected positive native children

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0.
**No new kappa. All five global selected assumptions remain.**

## Result

For each of the 3453 actual selected positive PAIDs, with fixed source rank
1<=r<=8, a literal private header translates **(f,t) to (r*f,r*t)** and
preserves the other21 values. The exact unchanged positive leaf now admits
its width precisely when the original parent has **f<=t**. This removes the
previous rank-only view's stronger requirement r*f<=parent t.

The cutoff consumer audit matters: the private numerical leaf uses cutoff
only for positivity and its admission comparison. Its actual axis kernel,
record geometry, fixed inventory and reservations receive no cutoff.
The public row system uses cutoff to decide elementary versus recursive
work, so the original parent remains unchanged and the translated view is
given exclusively to the positive leaf. A real row-table control exhibits
the incorrect branch change caused by mutating the public cutoff alone.

The two products are physically computed and retired on the same39 metadata
ports; the complete child still uses388 private ports. With E original header
bits, the translated header has at most E+12 bits, counting both self-delimited
values. Complete cost is
`F_template + O(r*f*V+(E+13)^4+388)`, including source access, all numerical
work, both metadata products, copies/restoration and cleanup. Old blank
backing remains charged role by role. Precision, disjoint placement, signed
prefix admission, source-to-machine and enclosing caller premises remain.

[PROOF.md](PROOF.md) states the universal lemma, exact source/consumer
restrictions, complete budget and historical backing. [SOURCE-AUDIT.json](SOURCE-AUDIT.json)
records its authenticated source-specific data-flow checks. This is a
positive-child interface result; no new complete MOVE is implemented here.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/current-leaf-cutoff-transport --check-only

```

Expected markers are `PASS_CURRENT_LEAF_CUTOFF_METADATA` and
`PASS_CURRENT_LEAF_CUTOFF_EVIDENCE`, in normal and optimized Python. The
registered commands run literal metadata/branch controls and recheck saved
numerical evidence; they do not rerun the long successful numeric call.

The120 metadata cases cover every source rank, accepted/rejected threshold
relations, canonical complete bytes, origins and cleanup. Additional257-bit
f and1025-bit cutoff specimens test encoded arithmetic and retained history;
they do not claim numerical producer admission. Controls reject the old
f-only table, zero fields, invalid source ranks, bad grants and cutoff leaking
into numerical width.

One actual event9934 rank-two leaf completed all4096 records at local parent
f=t=1, private f'=t'=2, with481525381 literal actions on388 ports in73.691 s
under120 s. Complete returned field/parent bytes are retained under `receipts/`.
The same original local threshold is rejected by the old f-only adapter;
that real old guard is re-executed in the bounded evidence gate. This local
fixture does not meet the separate global t>=145 convention and is not a
global caller witness, a complete MOVE, or an asymptotic timing result.

2. **Admit parent f<=t and numerical/stock bounds globally.** The new private

3. **Complete the numerical source-to-machine implication.** The metadata
